pcammes.summary: A manufacturing execution environment for tool, mould and precision engineering companies that connects production orders, resources, machines and shop-floor information.
pcammes.buyerProblem: Production data is fragmented across ERP, spreadsheets, machines and people, making planning, traceability and execution difficult to control in real time.
outcomes: Less searching for tools, parts and files

pcampps.summary: Production and process planning for single parts, products and small series, designed for mould shops and toolmakers.
pcampps.buyerProblem: Priorities, deadlines and resource availability change continuously, while planners need one coherent view of what can run, where and when.

pcammonitor.summary: Real-time supervision of connected CNC machines with machine state, program, cycle, downtime, setup, maintenance and OEE information.
pcammonitor.buyerProblem: Machine utilization and downtime are discussed from perception rather than measured from live machine data.

pcamiot.summary: IoT modules for collecting and presenting production-device data, including machine variables, energy use and environmental/process signals.
pcamiot.buyerProblem: Useful production signals exist inside controls and sensors, but are not consolidated into actionable shop-floor information.

pcamtoolmanager.summary: A tool-management system for identifying, locating, presetting and tracing holders and cutting tools across the workshop.
pcamtoolmanager.buyerProblem: Tool data, offsets, stock and physical location are disconnected, creating search time, setup risk and unnecessary inventory.

pcamcell.summary: Software for integrating multiple CNC machines and process resources into a coordinated automated cell.
pcamcell.buyerProblem: A robot can move parts, but true unattended production requires jobs, machines, pallets, tools and process constraints to be orchestrated together.

pcamjobmanager.summary: Job-management software for individual or connected CNC machines, supporting flexible routing, priorities, identification and process sequencing.
pcamjobmanager.buyerProblem: Small-batch production changes frequently and needs routing flexibility without losing control of programs, pallets, tools or execution order.

pcamwsm.summary: Workshop-management functions designed to simplify administrative work and improve visibility around production activities.
pcamwsm.buyerProblem: Shop-floor administrative tasks and status information are spread across disconnected workflows.
capabilities: Import/export through web services, SQL tables, text files and CSV
outcomes: More consistent exchange between business and production systems

pcamrobocube.summary: An enclosed automated handler for pallets and tools serving one to three CNC machines across milling, EDM, turning, grinding and measuring processes.
pcamrobocube.buyerProblem: A small group of machines needs autonomous loading with a compact footprint and enough storage for both pallets and tools.
capabilities: Support for milling, wire/sink EDM, turning, grinding and CMM

pcamfmc.summary: A flexible cell built around a 6-axis anthropomorphic robot for loading machines, magazines, washing/drying stations, load/unload positions and measuring machines.
pcamfmc.buyerProblem: Several process resources need one flexible handling system that can be configured around the workshop rather than forcing a fixed layout.

pcamfmc2.summary: A six-axis anthropomorphic robot solution designed to serve double machining cells and extend flexible automation across larger production layouts.
pcamfmc2.buyerProblem: One compact cell is not enough to cover the required machine count, process range or production layout.
outcomes: Reduced manual transfer between machining resources

pcamlinear.summary: Linear automation architecture for integrating four or more CNC machines and associated resources along a production line.
pcamlinear.buyerProblem: A central fixed robot cannot efficiently reach a long row of machines or a growing number of process stations.
capabilities: Six-axis robot on an extremely stable linear rail
outcomes: Reach more machines with one automation concept
Scale cell length as production evolves

pcamgantry.summary: A stable gantry that adds a horizontal seventh axis to the robot, allowing high-dynamic movement across large machine layouts.
pcamgantry.buyerProblem: Large multi-machine installations need robot reach without sacrificing payload, accessibility or layout freedom.
capabilities: Configurable machine, magazine and gripper layout

pcamheavy.summary: A pallet and tool handling concept for automated machining of large, heavy workpieces where compact cell payloads are not sufficient.
pcamheavy.buyerProblem: Large mould components or fixtures exceed the practical payload and resource capacity of compact automation systems.
capabilities: Load transport reported up to 8 t
outcomes: Extend unattended production to large workpieces

specs.label: Tool capacity
specs.value: Up to 3,000 HSK or ISO tools (current PCam page)

pcamcobot.summary: A collaborative 6-axis robot option for flexible CNC-related tasks, designed around repeatability, compact deployment and process inspection needs.
pcamcobot.buyerProblem: Automation must fit in constrained spaces and support flexible tasks without building a traditional large cell around every process.

pcamagv.summary: An automated guided vehicle concept for extending material movement beyond fixed machine cells.
pcamagv.buyerProblem: Parts and pallets must move between separated production areas without relying on continuous manual transport.

pcamcube.summary: Compact handling automation for workpieces and electrodes serving one to two machines in milling, EDM, grinding, washing and measuring workflows.
pcamcube.buyerProblem: A small machine group needs unattended loading, but floor space and investment must remain controlled.

pcamwire.summary: CAD/CAM programming for wire EDM, from CAD geometry through cutting strategies, machine post-processing and solid simulation.
pcamwire.buyerProblem: Complex wire EDM geometry and machine-specific programming create manual preparation, postprocessor and verification overhead.
integration: Exeron and other machine families via postprocessors

pcamdiesink.summary: CAD/CAM for die-sinking EDM, focused on turning extracted electrode geometry into controlled machine programming and automated EDM workflows.
pcamdiesink.buyerProblem: Electrode definition, setup and sink-EDM programming are disconnected steps that can introduce time loss and errors.

pcammms.summary: CAM-oriented programming for CNC coordinate measuring machines, reducing measurement preparation to defining required points and features on the solid model.
pcammms.buyerProblem: Measurement programming can become a bottleneck in high-mix precision production, especially when batches are small and geometry changes often.
capabilities: Visual CAD programming of measurement cycles
